text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Do you think ghosts really exist?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Where can you go to find them? And
must it
really be at night?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I heard that ghosts are people who have

unfinished business in this world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I would like to speak to them and ask
what it is
that keeps them so
passionately tied to our
realm.
